name: Katlit
source:
A descendant of the dragons who fought together with Fiusia during his crusade, but she is young and is initially unable to manifest her dragon form.

The unexpected death of her father Schuketor, the overlord of the dragon clans who reside in the mountain peaks guarding the passage through to Fia's intended destination, leads to Katlit's exile as Carmelg attempts to kill her and claim overlordship of the dragon clans through force of arms. Katlit with the help of loyal retainers escapes from the dragon domains and is eventually taken in by the old technician who later drops by the Fortress and allows Katlit to work in his stead as he recovers from injuries.

[Spoiler] Katlit eventually returns to her homeland and assumes overlordship of the dragon clans as her father did before her, but the circumstances of her succession vary depending on player actions. [/Spoiler]
